_comment: Mount Hermon corrections. (1) DEM-flat cable-car 2 (רכבל 2) stations both sampled at 1689 m; real bottom 1640 / top 1720. (2) The confluence where black #2 / red #3 / blue #6 meet (n13005215354/n2432015626/sn2432015626/n5608603092/n1104632744/n1732122152) was over-sampled at 1736-1745 m — above the lift-2 top — which reversed blue #6; real junction is ~1710 m, so blue #6 now descends from the lift-2 top into it. (3) The central T-bar top (n1099066123) skis out only via 4A in OSM but really also drops onto red Piste 12 at its nearest point (n387700621) — add that skiable connector. (4) רכבל מבקרים is a foot-passenger sightseeing gondola, not a ski lift — remove it from routing (the summit is still served by רכבל חדש / רכבל 7 / שיאון). (5) Piste 3A's long upper segment (n897571796→n897571820, ~720 m) was DEM-sampled with only a 3 m endpoint drop (noisy 1896-1998 m samples) so it became a dashed 2-way flat link; it is really a mellow descent. Raise its top n897571796 to ~1990 m so it re-derives as a one-way ~49 m descent. (6) Follow-up from the DEM cross-check (`npm run check:elevation`) + map verification: the same confluence was still off. n1732122152 is really its local high point (~1714 m) and n5608603094 was over-sampled by ~41 m (really ~1695 m) - the arrows ran uphill into n1732122152 from both n5608603092 and n5608603094. n2432015626 sits level with n1732122152 (the flat shoulder between them is skied both ways), so it is raised to 1712 m to fall inside pisteFlatTolerance and re-derive as a two-way traverse; n13005215354/sn2432015626 then have to rise with it to keep feeding downhill into n2432015626, which the DEM agrees with (it reads them at 1720 m). They are capped at 1716 m rather than the DEM's 1720 m so blue #6 keeps a clean one-way descent from the cable-car 2 top at 1720 m instead of going flat. Net field: n1098971023 1720 -> n13005215354/sn2432015626 1716 -> n2432015626 1712 <-> n1732122152 1714 -> n5608603092 1706 -> n1104632744 1703. n5608603094 still drains to n2432015629/sn2432015629 and nothing is stranded.
